programme.title: Monty Don Remembers... Geoff Hamilton
programme.desc: Described as 'the nation's head gardener', Geoff Hamilton combined vast horticultural knowledge with an ease at TV presenting that made everything he did look natural. He led Gardeners' World for 16 years, until his untimely death in 1996, as well as numerous other series, each displaying both his enthusiasm and his continual will to learn.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that the rambling roses have finished flowering, Monty turns his attention to pruning and tying in new growth for a good display next year. On the 20th anniversary of the death of Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost returns to the famous `Gardeners' World' location, Barnsdale, to pay tribute and to revisit some of his own early gardening memories. Also, we travel to Abergavenny to visit the garden of a sweet pea enthusiast to get her top tips for growing the best blooms.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Geoff Hamilton, Margaret Waddy and John Kelly present a programme from Barnsdale. Early August is an ideal time for propagation, and with this in mind, the team shows how to take softwood and semi-ripe cuttings and how to build a do-it-yourself propagator. Fuchsia expert John Smith joins the team, while in the vegetable area, attention turns to unusual vegetables such as pak choi, saladisi and chrysanthemum.

programme.title: Geoff Hamilton: A Man and His Garden

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
